title: Amagi Shien
overview:
I was hired as an apprentice assistant by the great detective Kindaichi Hifumi.

Apparently Mr. Kindaichi is a famous mystery writer who won a mystery literature award at the young age of 17, and his outstanding imagination and novel ideas were said to be every bit the equal of his many seniors. Several years later, no longer satisfied with the world of fiction, he set up a private detective agency as a hobby alongside his work as a best-selling author, and installed himself as its head.

Soon after I arrived at the agency, it was decided that I would go with Mr. Kindaichi to the Amagi Villa in Izu. Apparently he had been invited to the Amagi Villa's 60th anniversary party...

There, a variety of unexpected incidents awaited...

僕は、名探偵 金田一二三 に助手見習として雇われた。

なんでも金田一先生は、著名な推理作家で、若干17才にして推理小説文学賞を受賞し、その卓越した空想力と奇抜なアイデアは幾多の先輩に優るとも劣らなかったそうだ。それから数年後、虚構の世界に飽きたらず、売れっ子作家を営むかたわら、趣味で私立探偵事務所を設立し、自ら所長におさまったのだ。

事務所に着いた早々、金田一先生と伊豆の天城荘へ行くこととなった。なんでも天城荘の60周年パーティに招待されたそうだ・・・。

そこでは思いもよらぬ、様々な事件が待っていた・・・。
